title: Family Portrait Outdoors, 1965, B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white mid-1960s snapshot capturing a multi-generational family posing outdoors beside garden shrubbery and a residential home. The group consists of an older matriarch standing on the left, a young woman seated or kneeling holding a child in her lap, and a young man standing beside them wearing a short-sleeve button-up shirt and trousers. The reverse is marked in blue ink with '11-65', denoting November 1965.
